name: Ghanaian Language ASR Research
datasets_researched: Mozilla Common Voice, FLEURS, ALFFA, UGAkan
models_researched: Sherpa-ONNX, Whisper, Meta MMS, Seamless M4T
atypical_speech_gap: Critical. Zero data exists for atypical Ghanaian speech.
ghanaian_language_asr_gap: High. Very few offline-capable, commercially-cleared, pre-trained ONNX models exist.
tts_gap: Critical. No single-speaker studio datasets available for local TTS training.
code_switching_status: Unsupported. Monolingual datasets penalize code-switching, preventing model robustness.
safety_gap: Critical. Phase 12 English rules will fail on Ghanaian languages; requires complete translation.
recommendation_for_phase18: Focus on Atypical-Speech Adaptation (English) rather than raw Ghanaian-language ASR, aligning strictly with the accessibility mission.
limitations: No commercial open-source Twi model currently exists for Sherpa-ONNX.
